transitions.rationale: Chapter change at 15.0 from the setup block into the argument block. The analysis exposes no beat grid, so the turn is marked by a treatment change (0.4s blend) plus the shot-length step from 4.8s to 1.7s.
Chapter turn at 26.3 onto the payoff line - a soft luminance wipe into the speed ramp, chosen over blur/glitch because the frame is a calm talking head.
Breath at 30.0 after the slowed payoff: the black frame is the trigger the phase-3 whip-shake and the 0.25s brightness hit land out of, and it separates the ramp from the fast block.
Treatment change at 39.7 into the landing hold - the longest blend in the edit so the final 5.3s settles instead of cutting in cold. Not consecutive with the other crossfade (index 5).

audioDecisions.rationale: No separate audio file exists in the footage graph, so the podcast's own bed is the only continuous source. It runs unbroken under all 22 picture cuts (L-cut behaviour) which is what keeps the reel from truncating lines mid-sentence; held at 0.45 - well under the 0.6-0.8 music range - because the clip dialogue is the primary audio and this only smooths the jump cuts.
One-shot transient lifted from the source and re-timed onto the chapter change at 15.0 (crossfade out of the 4.8s hold into the 1.7s single) - the biggest structural cut of phase 1.
Impact hit timed exactly to the phase-3 entry at 30.0, where the dipToBlack releases into the whip-shake and the brightness accent - the loudest cut of the reel, so it gets the strongest sfx.

captionTemplate.safeArea: 9:16 - kept out of the top 10% and bottom 20%
captionTemplate.rationale: Single template so all dialogue callouts and captions share one voice; elements override only deliberately (hook/title get a heavier face and the upper band, the CTA gets a longer out-animation).

motionMoments.rationale: The only title card of the edit, placed after the 2-shot hook (contract: hook before any title card) and anchored to the chapter-open wide at 2.3s. One motion moment for the branding beat; nothing else is decorated.

metadata.rationale: 45s podcast-clip reel cut from a single 416.4s source (video-1, medium motion, conf 0.50). The analysis carries no beatTimestamps, no motionPeak values and no separate music file, so the spine is built on chapter/cadence structure instead of a beat grid: a 2-shot cold-open hook (0-2.0s) that lands before any title card, a 15s setup block, a 15s argument block that turns on a pitch-corrected speed ramp through the payoff line, and a 15s fast block that empties into a 5.3s held landing. Phase averages step 2.50s -> 1.88s -> 1.21s (excluding the landing), so phase 3 is measurably denser in shot count, camera-move amplitude and effect hits (1 -> 1 -> 3 accents). Treatment is face-safe throughout: one coherent colorGrade across all 22 shots, plus vignette/tonal/grain/sharpen/brightness/saturation accents only - no glitch, aberration or blur on the speakers. The source bed runs continuously under the picture cuts (L-cut behaviour) so no line is truncated mid-sentence; every picture cut is placed on a sentence/cadence boundary or a chapter turn.
